fusions.name: Gnaw Down
fusions.desc: A snapping blow that deals 4 damage, with a 30% chance of [Diseased] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Swarm Surge
fusions.desc: Looses 6 darting strikes in a spread, each dealing 3 damage and stunning the target for 0.8 seconds.

fusions.name: Last Off
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands.

fusions.name: Not Going Down
fusions.desc: When your health runs out, you regain 8 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 120 seconds.
